summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 1b in Part. Pass. (61/298)

data.turoyo: Kul ənsan minan ḥəzənni yo ʕal u abrayḏe, qəsəm ʕal u aḥunayḏe, qəsəm ʕal u ḥolayḏe, qəsəm ʕal u babayḏe, kul ḥa ʕal mede m diḏe, ḥzino yo.
data.translation: Jeder von uns trauert um einen Sohn, um einen Bruder, einen Onkel, einen Vater; jeder trauert um irgendeinen verwandten.

rationale: Fills a cell with three or fewer existing examples; independent, clear context.

summary: New sense 1b: (Detrans.) (mit ʕal) um j-n trauern, wegen j-s betrübt sein

data.label: 1b
data.gloss: (Detrans.) (mit ʕal) um j-n trauern, wegen j-s betrübt sein

rationale: 96/365 has Ḥəznina aʕle with an explicit mourned person and public mourning dress. 61/298 generalizes the same target coding to relatives; this is a constructional refinement, not a new emotion.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (MAC NE interview 1/15)

data.turoyo: Aḥna k̬lawšina ǧule maqalbe yani ḥəznina də‿Mšiho, dlaǧ+Ǧəhu ṣluwe.
data.translation: We wear some clothes inside out, like, we are sad that Christ ... that the Jews crucified him.

rationale: Sparse I Detransitive Preterit; first-person plural emotional-state predicate with an explanatory clause. Derivation remains an explicit question.

data.turoyo: <...> l Usuf Aġa makəmlelan ʕal u xwarəz diḏe w hati yo. Ḥəznina aʕle.
data.translation: <...> Jusuf Agha hat uns wegen seines Neffen schwarz gemacht. Das ist es; wir trauern um ihn. -

rationale: First indexed example of the I Detransitive ʕal mourning construction 1b.

data.turoyo: Alfaye w rəbwoṯo tawədyoṯo w šukriyat komšayʕina l kulxu w ġalabe mamnun, xəd mḥaznutu aʕman, Mšiḥo l obalxu ḥaznitiye.
data.translation: Euch allen sende ich tausendfachen, ja zehntausendfachen Dank; ich bin euch sehr dankbar dafür, dass ihr um mich getrauert habt. Christus möge euch keine Trauer mehr geben!

rationale: Fills a cell with three or fewer existing examples; independent, clear context.
The German past tense of beginnen is “begann”. The supplied translation of 21/55 also reads “begann er sich zu grämen”.

after: (Detrans.) traurig werden; (mit ʕal) um j-n trauern, sich um j-n Sorgen machen;
rationale: The existing LB 371/378 examples already have person-directed grief and concern. This clarifies meaning and government; it does not substitute terminology.

summary: Experiencers appear as the grammatical subject in these Detransitive predicates. ʕal marks the mourned or worried-about participant; the data do not show a suppressed causer. Concern can be for a living person (Talay 1/370-378), so the gloss must not entail death.

The existing gloss traurig werden is eventive, while ḥzino yo/we explicitly predicates a state. The proposed Part. Pass. box records that transparent state formation, but lexical-adjective status remains open.

ḥəznina in MAC NE interview 1/15 and 96/365 is provisionally kept with the inherited I Detransitive series. ḥəzənni in 26/200 and the first clause of 61/298 may be an Arabic-derived adjective; no new active I stem or base forms are invented.
The reader's context for 26/200 continues beyond the supplied verse and includes an additional promise. It was not quoted; no source material was reconstructed.
Do ḥəznina and ḥzino belong to the productive I Detransitive paradigm, or do some uses involve a lexical adjective? Confirm the distinction from ḥəzənni before adding that token as a finite example.
Does ḥəznina in 96/365 mark an attained/current grief state or the onset of grief? The context alone does not decide its aspect.
For the target construction, is də‿Mšiho in MAC NE interview 1/15 an independent stimulus phrase or the start of a repaired explanatory clause? It is not conflated with clear ʕal government.
